title: What It Actually Looks Like to Talk Trash With the Guys and Still Walk With God
caption:
The fantasy football chat and the Bible study aren't supposed to require two different guys.

The line was never volume. It's target. Ragging on the game is fine. Aiming it at a man's marriage, his kid, or his job stops being banter and starts being cruelty with a laugh track.

Say the thing you'd say to his face. If a chat only holds what you'd never say out loud, it's not friendship anymore, it's a mask with a group name. And some threads you're supposed to outgrow on purpose, not just let go quiet.

Same trash talk, same guy who prays. That's not two versions of you. That's a man who's actually whole.

#faith #brotherhood #godlymen #christianmen #integrity
